messages:
Aisha Khan: Hey folks—first day! My monitor + stand shipment shows delivered but nothing at my desk. Also Wi‑Fi won't let me join RW-Employee; I get 'auth failed'. I opened ticket #4589 but wanted to ping here. Desk: 8th floor, desk 8B. Any quick help? @Jordan - IT
Delivery Bot: Package LR-847 marked DELIVERED to 8th floor at 09:12 — signed by 'M. Ortiz' https://tracker.example.com/LD847
Jordan - IT: Hey @Aisha Khan — welcome! I'll check ticket #4589. Can you confirm the MAC/serial of your laptop or send a photo of the docking station? Also try forgetting the Wi‑Fi and rejoining; password is in 1Password under 'RW-WiFi — Employee' (DM me if you can't access it).
Aisha Khan: Thanks Jordan. I can't access 1Password yet — 2FA email didn't come through. Laptop serial: C02X12345G8M. Photo attached.
Delivery Bot: Update: Courier scan shows delivery to front desk, not your desk. Escalating to Facilities for retrieval.
Chris M. (Facilities): Sorry about that — we'll check 7th/9th floor common areas and front desk. @Sam Lee from shipping, can you confirm the courier scan notes?
Sam Lee: Courier notes: 'delivered to front desk, recipient M. Ortiz' — front desk has box 42. @Aisha Khan can you swing by front desk? If not, we can re-route to your desk and sign for it.
Aisha Khan: I can pick up, thanks. Quick Q: the docking station only has 2 USB-C ports; will I get an extra monitor cable? Also my keyboard lights flicker when plugged into dock.
Jordan - IT: Bring the dock to the IT bench (room 201) if the keyboard flickers — we'll swap cables and test. We have HDMI->USB-C adapters in locker B3 for extra monitor connectors. If you'd like, I can come by in ~30m and set it up.
Maya R. (People Ops): Welcome Aisha!! :tada: If you need anything else onboarding-wise ping me. New hires lunch at 12 if you want to join the table.
Aisha Khan: Picking up box now. Jordan I'll flag if flicker persists. Ticket #4589 updated.
IT-Bot: Ticket #4589 status changed: In Progress — assigned to Jordan. ETA update expected within 2 hours.
Jordan - IT: Quick update: swapped dock cable, updated keyboard firmware, resent Wi‑Fi 2FA and confirmed Aisha can now join RW-Employee. Monitor re-routed and delivered to desk at 10:46. Marking this thread resolved — reply if anything else pops up :thumbsup:
Aisha Khan: All good now, everything works. Thanks team!! :heart:
